title: Actionwave: A Systematic Benchmark for Waveform-Centric Clinical Prediction Across Care Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2611.31249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous bedside waveforms record rapid physiological changes that can inform clinical decisions. Existing benchmarks examine selected prediction conditions, but it remains unclear how model advantages depend on signal duration, warning time, and available inputs across care settings. We introduce Actionwave, a benchmark for waveform-centric clinical prediction across intensive-care, operating-room, and emergency-department settings. Actionwave uses a common decision-time prediction interface and groups clinically grounded tasks by what is inferred and when. It varies conditions relevant to clinical use, including the warning required before an intervention. We compare diverse architectures and pretrained biosignal encoders under specified model-size and compute budgets. The protocol requires patient-level splits, strict information cutoffs, and comparisons that isolate individual modeling factors. Across 20 tasks and 1.4M task-label

translated_title: Actionwave：面向多种医疗场景的以波形为中心的临床预测系统性基准
translated_abstract: 连续的床旁波形记录了快速的生理变化，可为临床决策提供信息。现有的基准测试仅考察了选定的预测条件，但目前尚不清楚模型优势如何依赖于信号时长、预警时间以及不同医疗场景下的可用输入。我们提出了 Actionwave，这是一个面向重症监护、手术室和急诊科场景的以波形为中心的临床预测基准。Actionwave 采用统一的决策时点预测接口，并根据推断的内容和时间对具有临床依据的任务进行分组。它改变了与临床使用相关的条件，包括干预前所需的预警时间。我们在指定的模型规模和计算预算下，比较了多种架构和预训练生物信号编码器。该协议要求患者级数据划分、严格的信息截断，以及能够隔离单个建模因素的比较。在 20 个任务和 140 万个任务标签……
tldr: Actionwave 是首个覆盖重症监护、手术室和急诊科等多种医疗场景的以波形为中心的临床预测系统性基准，通过统一的决策时点预测接口、严格的评估协议，系统考察了信号时长、预警时间和可用输入等条件对模型表现的影响。
en_tdlr: Actionwave is a systematic benchmark for waveform-centric clinical prediction across ICU, operating-room, and emergency-department settings, featuring a unified decision-time prediction interface and rigorous evaluation protocol to systematically assess how signal duration, warning time, and available inputs affect model performance.
